name: Dong-gyun
source:
Dong-gyun is a young demon of the nation of Avisos. He is an avid fan of Beelzebub as well as the rulers of the 72 demon legion.

He fell for the Main Character during a night where Beelzebub and the MC were drinking at a bar in Avisos under a spell to disguise the two. He helped carry MC to the palace, where he instantly fell head-over-heels.

Beelzebub ended up tattooing the word "cute" on his buttcheek, and Dong-gyun wasn't particularly offended by it. In fact, he was elated and couldn't wait for MC to return to Avisos.
